title: Reset leaves the filter selects on their old values
expected: URL /edges with every select back to All / Any / A + B / Biggest edge.
actual: URL becomes /edges and the list is unfiltered, but the selects still read sport=cbb, grade=A, sort=start (uncontrolled defaultValue is not re-applied on client navigation). The form shows filters that are not applied; a fresh load of /edges shows the defaults. Same stale state is likely after browser back/forward between filter URLs.
evidence: tickets/evidence/EFP-001.png; /tmp/claude-0/qa/ui2.js printed 'sport=cbb type=all book=all min= grade=A sort=start' after Reset
suspected_area: app/src/app/edges/page.tsx: selects use defaultValue; Reset is a next/link. Key the form on the filter string, or make Reset a plain <a>/reload.
